event_definitions.move: every predicted living opponent unit with a well-formed recorded reply; label: its submitted move, stay when infeasible
event_definitions.act: the same units; label: wait / pickup / drop / attack after the projected move, effectless or targetless actions as wait
event_definitions.target: units whose act label is attack on a target in one of P's eight candidate slots; label: that slot

scope: factual states of recorded games only; P2/P3 differences here are prediction differences, not strength
